sources.summary: This call for entries is open to all architects, students of architecture, landscape architects, interior designers, artists and industrial designers who have a proven portfolio of design work. It is the intention of this competition to foster and encourage the formation of multi-disciplinary teams. The huts or installations are placed along the Nestaweya River Trail at The Forks in Winnipeg, Manitoba ( www.theforks.com ). The Forks is located in downtown Winnipeg, at the junction of the Red River and the Assiniboine River.
